guard: a persona definition the manager could not load back is refused before anything is written (#5404)
why: The suite calls define-persona on a real manager through its ep door, so the refusal comes from the shipped writer.
P1 writes the file without reading it back, so a subscribe entry outside allowSubscribe is saved and every later load of that name fails.
The command builds core, which the manager imports from dist/, so P1's afterRestore rebuilds it, leaving no dist/ compiled from the mutant.
